name: Ame ~The Rain~
source:
Main character is at a loss under the rain when he meets a girl with a healing smile. She invites him to live at her place till it stops to rain, e.g. under the same roof with three cute girls. The weather forecast shows that it's going to rain for at least a week more.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在雨中不知所措，邂逅了一名笑容治愈人心的女孩。她邀请他在雨停前暂住自己家中，也就是说，他将与三名可爱女孩同住一个屋檐下。天气预报显示，这场雨至少还会持续一周。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
